newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady amid caution on Iraqi oil.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady amid caution on Iraqi oil.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures settled steady late Tuesday but no trade was done as players held back, cautious and watchful of further Iraq news, brokers said.

The final resumption of Iraqi crude on Tuesday has caused the market to soften, a broker said. This, coupled with the warmer than expected weather in the United States has weighed down prices, he said.
January Brent was last bid/offered at $23.84/$23.90 per barrel but settled untraded at $24.10, unchanged from its last International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) close.
NYMEX January crude on the after-hours ACCESS fell to $25.05, 25 cents below its last official close.
